items.name: WorkTable
items.summary: The name is from PostgreSQL's terminology. See <https://wiki.postgresql.org/wiki/CTEReadme#How_Recursion_Works> This table serves as a mirror or buffer between each iteration of a recursive query.

items.name: WorkTableExec
items.summary: A temporary "working table" operation where the input data will be taken from the named handle during the execution and will be re-published as is (kind of like a mirror).
